systems_of_record: Xero, the issuing company's file (the intercompany invoice and its InvoiceID)
Xero, the receiving company's file (the bill entered for the same charge, carrying the issuer's InvoiceID as its reference)

emits.write: the month-end intercompany run into the group's reconciliation log: the pair contract id, the key it joined on (the issuer's Xero InvoiceID), the master per field, and the five counts (matched, within tolerance, mismatched, orphaned, corrected), the all-clear included
emits.readback: the log returns a report_id, and reading that id back returns the run with its contract id and counts; no id back means the run did not publish and the contract owner is told

emits.write: an exception on the issuer's Xero InvoiceID naming the contract owner: an open difference with both figures and the master's figure awaiting acceptance, an entry in one company's file with no partner in the other, a gap over the threshold amount, a run over the mismatch rate, or an accepted correction whose write returned no id
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading it back returns the issuer's InvoiceID, the reason and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops

nodes.name: Invoice Desk
nodes.office_task: When a job is marked complete, put its draft invoice in Xero at our own prices, park what it cannot price, and send only once a named person or their rule releases it.
systems_of_record: the job system that issues the job_id (ServiceM8, Simpro, or a job sheet)
Xero, which issues the invoice_id

emits.write: One draft invoice in Xero per completed job, keyed to the job id (reference job:<id>, and the stage under a building contract), every line a job line priced from the Xero Items read at draft time, carrying the book edition and any signed variation acceptance.
emits.readback: The invoice is read back from the ledger by the job id (Xero GET /api.xro/2.0/Invoices/{InvoiceID}) and must return the same invoice id, its external id and the job id. No id back is not a write: it raises invoice.write_failed and the run stops.

emits.write: The release on the invoice record, naming the person who closed the awaiting-release exception or the rule (with its threshold) that person set, then the send from the ledger. Nothing parked is ever sent.
emits.readback: The invoice read back by its id shows status sent, the sent time, and released_by or released_by_rule, with the release before the send.

emits.write: A parked or waiting invoice as an exception on the job: the reason from the standard's fixed list (not_in_pricebook, unsigned_variation, no_stage, write_failed) or awaiting_release, the job id, the invoice id, the unpriced codes with no rate, and exception_owner set to the person the business named for invoices.
emits.readback: The exception desk returns the exception against the job id, and reading it back returns the job_id, invoice_id, reason and exception_owner; the next hop reads it there and stops.

emits.write: the morning summary, once a day at the set time and also when nothing is open: open items by type and by owner, the overdue ones, the labels that arrived as other, and every vehicle or job with failed check items still open
emits.readback: the place the office reads it (an email, a Teams channel or a sheet tab) returns a report_id for that day, and a second run that morning reads it back and publishes nothing

nodes.name: Price Creep

systems_of_record: Xero or MYOB (the ledger that issues the bill_id and holds the supplier bills)
the agreed supplier price list or trade account schedule of rates, by its reference, in the ledger or the job system (Simpro, ServiceM8 or similar)
the document store holding the bill PDFs and any written approval for an item not on the price list

emits.write: a check note on the supplier bill in the ledger: every line priced against the agreed price list it names, each rise or drop in dollars, the tolerance in force with its date, the other three checks (delivered quantity, items not on the list, order total), and the bill placed in the done-and-reversible list for a named person to approve. Nothing is approved or paid
emits.readback: reading the bill by its bill_id from the ledger (Xero GET /api.xro/2.0/Invoices/{bill_id}/History, or the MYOB bill's journal memo) returns the check note with the four results and seam.queue = done_reversible; no note back means it was not written and the bill is raised as an exception instead

emits.write: an exception on the bill naming the person who owns it: the first check that failed and the checks that never ran, the price rise in dollars line by line, the price list it was read against, the bill PDF, and its queue (needs a decision for a price rise, quantity or order-total overrun; waiting on the supplier for a missing bill PDF; or blocked: no price list named, or an item not on the list with no written approval)

the recorded sales source the agency already licenses
the document store the approved page and its record of what was shown are published into, which issues the report_id

nodes.name: Progress Desk

emits.write: One claim draft per contract per month, written into the contract record and keyed contract:<contract id>:<period>: every schedule line with its scheduled value, the percent complete the project manager entered this month with their name and the date, value to date, claimed before and this claim in cents, totals that are the sums of the lines, each signed variation with its signed acceptance attached, the waiver version, and the words "DRAFT: not a payment claim until reviewed and served by you". emits.write: A parked draft or a stopped run as an exception on the contract record: the reason (no_waiver_acceptance, schedule_mismatch, no_assessment, unsigned_variation, below_previous or write_failed), the contract id, the period, the lines left out, and exception_owner set to the contract's project manager, or to the account owner for no_waiver_acceptance.

Xero (Items as the service price list, Quotes)

Simpro
Xero

emits.write: A parked quote as an exception on the job: the park reason from the standard's fixed list, the priced lines, no total, and exception_owner set to the person the business named for quotes.
emits.readback: The job read by its id shows the open exception with its exception_owner; the next hop reads it there and stops.

the exception desk the business runs (a sheet or a task list that issues the exception_id)

the receipt register kept beside it, one open item per line with no receipt, owed by the person who spent it
the practice's mailbox (Gmail or Outlook), where a receipt sent back on the chase thread arrives with its message id

nodes.name: Recharge Desk

Xero, which issues the invoice_id

the exception desk the business runs, which issues the exception_id

the place the agent opens each morning (CRM tasks, the Today tab or a morning email), which issues the report_id for each day's list

the tech licence register the business keeps

the asset register that issues the asset_id (each smoke alarm and RCD on the property, by the tag printed on it)

nodes.name: Tier Quote
nodes.office_task: When a job is booked, draft one quote with good, better and best options from our own tier list, each line at our own price-list rate, or park it, and leave it for us to send.
systems_of_record: ServiceM8
Simpro
Xero (Items as the price list, Quotes)

emits.write: One draft quote on the job it was drafted from, ex GST, holding two or three named options (Good, Better and Best unless the business renames them), in the tier list's order and under its labels. Every line in every option is a catalogue id the tier list names for that kind of work, at the rate read from the business's own price list at draft time; each option carries its own total and there is no sum across options. Where the system cannot hold options on one quote, one draft per option carries the job id and the option label and the set counts as the one quote. It is left in draft for the person who owns quotes; this node has no way to send it, mark the customer's choice or void an option.
emits.readback: The quote is read back by the id the system returned (ServiceM8 GET /api_1.0/jobquote/{uuid}.json, Simpro GET /api/v1.0/companies/{companyID}/quotes/{quoteID}, Xero GET /api.xro/2.0/Quotes/{QuoteID}) and must carry the job id and every option label. No id back is not a write: it raises quote.write_failed.

emits.write: A parked quote as an exception on the job: the park reason from the standard's fixed list (not_in_pricebook, variation_to_accepted_quote, discount_requested, pricebook_unreadable, no_tier_map, too_many_options), each option's priced lines, the line that did not price and the option it was in, no total, and exception_owner set to the person the business named for quotes. Once a person marks the option the customer chose, the same owner is told which other options to void or decline.
emits.readback: The exception desk returns an exception_id; reading the job by its id shows the open exception with its exception_owner, and the next hop reads it there and stops.

nodes.name: Timesheet Billing
nodes.office_task: When a client's timesheet period closes, draft its invoice in Xero from the hours at our rate card, park what it cannot price, and hold it for a named person to release.
systems_of_record: the job system that holds each client engagement's billing periods, with the time entries filed from the staff's emailed timesheets, and issues the period's id (carried as job_id)
Xero, which issues the invoice_id

emits.write: One draft invoice in Xero per closed billing period, referenced job:<period id> (and the stage under a fixed-stage contract), every line one of the period's time entries or expenses with its timesheet entry reference in the notes, every rate read from the rate card at draft time, and the client's signed approval attached for out-of-scope hours. A second completion event updates the same draft.
emits.readback: Xero returns the InvoiceID; GET /api.xro/2.0/Invoices/{InvoiceID} must return the invoice with Reference job:<period id>, and that id is stamped on the period as seam.invoice_id. No id back is not a write: it raises invoice.write_failed and the run stops.

emits.write: The invoice leaves only after a release naming the accounts officer, or naming the rule they set and showing the total is under its threshold; the release and the send time are recorded against the period.
emits.readback: GET /api.xro/2.0/Invoices/{InvoiceID} returns it AUTHORISED and sent to the contact, and the period read by its id shows seam.released_by (a person or a rule) before the send time. A send with no release on the record is refused.

emits.write: A parked or waiting invoice as an exception on the billing period: the reason from the standard's fixed list (not_in_pricebook, unsigned_variation, write_failed) or over_threshold, the period id, the invoice id, the codes left unpriced, and exception_owner set to the person the firm named for billing.
emits.readback: The exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading it back returns the job_id, the invoice_id, the reason and the exception_owner; the next run reads it there and stops until exception.closed.

port_of.original_name: Convert emailed timesheets into QuickBooks invoices with OCR, AI, Gmail and Sheets

nodes.name: Trim Quote
nodes.office_task: When a finish-carpentry job has its labour hours on it, draft the quote as hours times our own sell-rates, or park it with a reason, and leave it for us to send.
systems_of_record: ServiceM8
Simpro
Xero (Items as the price list, Quotes)

emits.write: A draft quote on the job it was drafted from, ex GST. Each line carries a catalogue id from the business's own price list, that item's sell-rate as read at draft time, and the quantity from the job: labour hours for an hourly line. The amount is quantity times rate and nothing else. It is left in draft, editable, for the person who owns quotes; this node has no way to send it.
emits.readback: The quote is read back by the id the system returned (ServiceM8 GET /api_1.0/jobquote/{uuid}.json, Simpro GET /api/v1.0/companies/{companyID}/quotes/{quoteID}, Xero GET /api.xro/2.0/Quotes/{QuoteID}) and must carry the job id. No id back is not a write: it raises quote.write_failed.

emits.write: A parked quote, or a job sent back for hours, as an exception on the job: the park reason from the standard's fixed list (or hours_missing), the lines that did price with their catalogue ids, the work that did not, no total, and exception_owner set to the person the business named for quotes.
emits.readback: The exception desk returns an exception_id; reading the job by its id shows the open exception with its exception_owner, and the next hop reads it there and stops.

nodes.name: Van Board
nodes.office_task: Turn each service work order into a dispatch package: verified address, a licensed tech at a time that fits, customer and tech told once, the rest handed to the dispatcher.
systems_of_record: the job system that issues the job_id and holds its schedule (ServiceM8, Simpro or Jobber)
the tech licence register the business keeps

emits.write: the dispatch package on the work order: one slot on the job's schedule (tech, start, end, resolved address, the rule or named dispatcher that set it, what displaced it), updated in place on a change and never written twice, with the customer confirmation attached as evidence
emits.readback: the job system returns the slot's external id, and reading the job's slot back by job_id returns that external id and the job version it was made for; no id back is a failed write, escalated as write_failed, and nothing is sent

emits.write: an escalation on the work order naming its owner: an address that will not resolve, no tech with a current licence for the work, a window too short for the job, no capacity, no consent to message the customer, a failed slot write, or a displaced job that could not be re-slotted
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the job_id, the reason and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops

nodes.name: Van Stock
nodes.office_task: Reserve what the van and store already hold for each job, order only the shortfall from the approved wholesaler at catalogue price, and match every docket back.
systems_of_record: the job system that issues the job_id, holds its material list and its van and store stock (ServiceM8, Simpro, Tradify, Fergus or similar)
the wholesaler portal or job-system purchasing that issues each order's external id

emits.write: one purchase order per job and supplier, for the lines van and store stock do not cover, priced from that supplier's catalogue read at order time, released by the threshold rule or a named person and sent against the job
emits.readback: the ordering system returns the order's external id, and reading that id back returns the job_id, the supplier, the lines, the catalogue edition and the release; no id back means it was not written and it is parked with a person named

emits.write: the delivery docket matched to its sent order on the job, line by line, with the quantity received and a reason (short, damaged, substituted) on any line that differs
emits.readback: reading the job's record by job_id returns the delivery against the order's id with its docket id and every line; a docket that matches no sent order is not recorded and is raised instead

emits.write: an exception on the job or the order naming the person who owns it: an order waiting for a named release (over the threshold, or to a supplier not on the approved list), a code no catalogue holds, an order write with no id back, a docket that matches no sent order, and every delivery variance (short, over, wrong item, changed price, damage, unaccepted substitution)
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the job_id, the order id where one exists, the kind and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops

nodes.name: Variation Chase
nodes.office_task: Each weekday, chase the signature on every variation the office has approved, stop the day it comes back signed, and hand a no or a silent party to a named person.
systems_of_record: the job system's variation register, one open item per approved variation awaiting signature on the job (Simpro, ServiceM8 or a Google Sheet kept beside the job system), which issues the job_id and the item id
the office mailbox (Gmail or Outlook) the signed variation comes back to, which issues the message_id

emits.write: the signed variation (or the certificate, PO number or form the job waited on) filed as evidence against its open item on the job, which marks the item arrived so the variation can go on the next progress claim
emits.readback: reading the item back by its id returns status arrived with the arrival's evidence reference, which names the message_id of the email that carried the signed copy and the job_id it belongs to; no evidence reference back means it was not filed, and the item gets no touch until a person looks

emits.write: an escalation on the item naming the cadence's person: the other side said no, disputed the variation or asked us to stop, or the item reached its cap with nothing back, carrying every touch so far
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the item id, the job_id, the reason, the touch history and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops

nodes.name: Vendor Actuals
nodes.office_task: Check each supplier invoice against its purchase order and what the supplier has claimed to date, clear what matches for a person to approve, and hand the rest to a named owner.
systems_of_record: Xero or MYOB (the ledger that issues the bill_id and holds the purchase orders)
the record of work marked complete against each purchase order (the job system or schedule of rates)
the document store where the invoice copies and written variation approvals live (Google Drive or SharePoint)

emits.write: a clean match stamped on the bill: the purchase order it names, the four check records with what each saw (agreed and invoiced rate, quantity complete less claimed before, written variation approvals, claimed to date against the contract sum plus approved variations), the dated tolerances used, and queue done_reversible, waiting for a named person to approve. Nothing is approved or paid.
emits.readback: the bill read back from the ledger by its bill_id returns seam.order_ref, seam.queue = done_reversible and the four passed check records; no bill back by that id means nothing was stamped, an exception is raised and the run stops

emits.write: an exception on the bill naming the person who owns supplier invoices: the check that failed and the checks that never ran, the difference in dollars, the cumulative position, the source document, and its queue (needs a decision, sorted by dollars at risk; waiting on the supplier for a copy; or blocked: no purchase order named, or scope with no written approval)
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the bill_id, the failed check, the dollar difference, the source document and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops

nodes.name: Vendor Pack
nodes.office_task: Read each vendor's licence and insurance papers as they land, log the key fields and expiry dates, and hold anything unsure, missing or expired for a named person.
systems_of_record: the document store that issues the document_id (Google Drive or SharePoint)
the vendor register that holds the graph and the pack queues, issuing the report_id and exception_id

emits.write: the vendor's pack: one handover artefact derived from the graph (ABN, legal name, address, each document's class, number and expiry), every clause citing its dated rule, an as-of date and the named person's version record, released only after that person accepted this exact version
emits.readback: the vendor register returns a report_id for the pack, and reading that id back returns the pack's queue, its as-of date and the version record naming the person; a refused handover returns no id and nothing was published

emits.write: the pack moved to Yellow (a field read below the confidence gate), Hold (an applicable document missing) or Fail (ABN not active, a name or ABN mismatch, an expired document, no rule in force), with the reason and the vendor's exception_owner
emits.readback: the vendor register returns an exception_id, and reading it back returns the pack id, the queue, the first check that stopped it with the reason, and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops

nodes.name: Visit Round
nodes.office_task: Each period, book the next visit on every maintenance contract with a licensed tech inside the customer's window, and hand lapsed contracts and visits no tech is free for to a named person.
systems_of_record: the job system that issues the job_id, raises each contract's next visit job and holds its schedule (ServiceM8, Simpro or Jobber)
the tech licence register the business keeps

emits.write: the contract visit's booking on its job: one slot on the job's schedule (licensed tech, start, end, resolved address, the rule or named dispatcher that set it, what displaced it), updated in place when the visit changes and never written twice, with the customer confirmation attached as evidence
emits.readback: the job system returns the slot's external id, and reading the job's slot back by job_id returns that external id and the job version it was booked for; no id back is a failed write, escalated as write_failed, and nothing is sent

emits.write: an escalation on the visit job naming its owner: a contract that has lapsed (to the contract owner), an address that will not resolve, no tech with a current licence for the work, a window too short for the visit, no tech free in the window, no consent to message the customer, a failed slot write, or a visit moved off by an emergency that could not be re-booked
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the job_id, the reason and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops
